title: chore(pm): run the mailbox-open self-test in CI and pin the roster fixture lanes to its lane-word lists
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DGFvM99dFuz4YKM4noaMUMS)_

Fixes #27997

## What changes

- `package.json` `check:pm-record-recognisers` now chains `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` (71 cases in 10 batteries). The existing `Lint & Repo Gates` step (`.github/workflows/lint.yml:1275`) runs that script, so no workflow job is added.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` gains one case in the fixture-snapshot battery (floor 17 → 18): every distinct lane in the fixture rows (`repo:hotcrm`, `domain:devx`, `domain:skills`, `triage`, `domain:ui`) is a kind from `SEAT_LANE_KINDS` or a word from `SEAT_BARE_LANES`, read through the already-imported `mailbox-open.mjs` namespace, never re-spelled.

## Why

Should-fixes 2 and 3 from the contract review of PR #27986: the reserved-lane refusal pinned in `mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` ran in no CI job, and nothing asserted that the roster's fixture lanes stay inside the exported lane-word lists.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers` → exit 0; the chain prints `✓ mailbox-open self-test: 71 cases in 10 batteries pass.`
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` → `✓ fleet-roster self-test: 83 cases in 8 batteries pass.`
- Ablation (scratch copy): `SEAT_BARE_LANES` set to `['director']` → the new case fails with `triage:false`, exit 1.
- No import cycle: `fleet-roster.mjs` already imported `mailbox-open.mjs` on `main`; no new import line.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 38 families on 66f3f154; all 38 exit 0 (four needed a whole-tree `pnpm build` first), and `--ran` reconciles 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `eslint scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` exit 0.
- Tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test package.json scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` → 0 of 2 paths governed.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把信箱开箱脚本的自测接进已有的 CI 检查链,并让车队总表自测断言夹具里的车道词都在导出的词表中。
- 为什么改:#27986 合同复核的两条应修项;此前保留车道名的拒绝只在本地自测里,CI 不跑,改坏了也是绿的。
- 风险与回滚:只动一条 npm 脚本和一个自测用例,不改运行逻辑;回滚即还原这次提交。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` 新增的那一条断言。
- 两分钟验证:跑 `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`,末行应是 mailbox-open 71 例通过。
- 需要你做的:无;不欠合同复核(四个契约面都没碰),落地档位以登记表为准。

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — nothing here publishes (`skip-changeset`).
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to generated docs or changelogs.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
